newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent firmer, supported by NYMEX rebound.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent firmer, supported by NYMEX rebound.

text.p: April Brent crude futures were traded at firmer levels on Monday in a modest rebound from a late slump in values on Friday.
April Brent was traded at $18.98 per barrel on SIMEX, up 13 cents from London. London April Brent fell 50 cents on Friday, falling below support at $19.00.
Brokers said they expected a rebound from current levels or from the slightly lower support area of $18.60/$18.70 on the front-month position.
One broker said a rebound could take prices to $21.50/$22.00 on the basis of a 50-percent retracement of the slump in prices so far this year.
NYMEX April crude was firmer on ACCESS. It last traded at $20.37 per barrel, up seven cents from New York on Friday.
Brokers said sentiment remained bearish because of the late sell off on Friday. Most volume seemed attracted to the downside moves rather than rebounds, one broker said.
